modifications: Generalized the source's group-32 row matvec to the artifact's 4-bit group-64 dense projections while preserving row-independent arithmetic.
Added a separate byte-wide q8/group-64 Metal kernel for the Qwen4 artifact; q4 nibble scaling remains isolated to the original q4 path.
Added an explicit per-arm enable bit so one loaded model can compare ordinary and TensorFold row laws without reinstalling weights.
Restricted installation to eligible dense projections; streamed PLE and routed expert weights remain owned by mlx2.
Use one numerical law at both one-row decode and multi-row verification, bind the policy and counters to route receipts, and leave the ordinary route available as reference.
qualification: The q4 candidate is implemented, row-invariant, performance no-go, default-off, unqualified and unselected; its prior M5 exact-shape sweep was slower in 11 of 12 cells. The new q8 law is implemented and CPU-checked but unqualified and unselected. A bounded q8 Metal oracle compiled at row widths 1, 3 and 16 with maximum BF16 differences of 0.0078125, 0.0078125 and 0.015625 versus stock QMM, so full-model token identity and performance must be established independently.
